events.event_name: SEC Evernorth Form 424B3 — SBI resale and lock-up
events.hypothesis: The SEC prospectus registers substantial potential XRPN resale capacity and identifies a large SBI-controlled Class A position.
events.counter_hypothesis: The registered 73.688M is not all outstanding; it includes potential conversions/exchanges/warrants. General resale language references lock-up provisions, while the specific signatory list names Ripple, Sponsor and Contributor Related Party Entity, not SBI. SBI's contractual restriction is unresolved. Registration is not proof of sale; holder resales yield no issuer proceeds.
events.claim: The Nov 9 filing registers up to 73,688,162 Class A shares: 19,102,635 issued, 31,392,746 potential Class C conversions, 22,953,128 potential Company Unit redemptions/exchanges and 239,653 warrant exercise shares. SBI-controlled entities hold 9,431,914 Class A and 2,359,038 non-voting, unlisted, non-transferable Class C shares; 39.9% group ownership cap. Specific lock-up signatories cover 7,044,386 Class A shares (29.8% of Oct 9 outstanding).
assumptions: SEC tables are accurate as of stated dates.
Generic lock-up language does not by itself resolve SBI's executed obligations.
falsification_conditions: Executed SBI agreement/side letter or transfer-agent record establishes restrictions.
Subsequent SEC filing establishes completed resales.
